title: Amounts a landlord may require at the start of a tenancy
scope_note: Applies to residential real property. The statute permits only specified initial payments, subject to statutory exceptions and any authorized security-deposit alternative.

title: Security-deposit handling and tenant notices
scope_note: Covers statutory receipt, account, interest, recordkeeping, and related requirements for residential security deposits.

title: Statement of condition for a security deposit
scope_note: Applies when a residential lessor accepts a security deposit; the statutory timing and tenant response period are specific.

title: Return of security deposit and deductions
scope_note: Rules and exceptions are detailed; a lease review cannot determine whether a particular deduction is justified.

title: Remedies for certain security-deposit violations
scope_note: The statute provides different remedies for specific violations; do not infer a remedy from a clause alone.

title: Timing of rent penalties
scope_note: The text addresses interest or penalties for failure to pay rent; it does not resolve every kind of fee.

title: Entry, quiet enjoyment, and services
scope_note: Section 14 applies to residential premises within its terms; Section 15B(1)(a) addresses permitted landlord entry before a lease ends. The statutes do not establish one general notice period for every entry.

title: Certain statutory protections cannot be waived
scope_note: Only the specific provisions and exceptions stated in those sections are covered; this is not a general rule that all lease terms are non-waivable.

title: Certain tenant claims and defenses in possession cases
scope_note: This provision concerns claims or defenses in specified possession actions and includes conditions and procedures. It is not a general habitability checklist or advice to withhold rent.

title: Protection from retaliation for specified tenant activity
scope_note: Covers specified reporting, legal, utility, and tenant-organization activity; the statute includes a rebuttable presumption and exceptions.

title: Interest on last month's rent paid in advance
scope_note: Applies to rent paid in advance for the last month of a tenancy; statutory rates, payment timing, and exceptions matter.

title: Notice to end an estate at will
scope_note: This section concerns estates at will and is not a general termination rule for every fixed-term lease.

title: Residential services and utilities
scope_note: Covers specified services and circumstances under the statute; separate laws may govern particular utilities or building conditions.
